data.title: Speeding fine (Bußgeldbescheid) from Kreis Beispielborken - 132.00 EUR
data.summary: The Kreis Beispielborken Bussgeldstelle issued a fine notice for speeding 23 km/h over the 100 km/h limit on 5 October 2026. The total amount due is 132.00 EUR and 1 point is recorded in the driving register; the notice was formally delivered on 24 November 2026.
data.explanation: This is an official fine notice from the Kreis Beispielborken traffic authority for a speeding offense on 5 October 2026. It totals 132.00 EUR (fine, fee and delivery costs) and adds 1 point to the driving register. You may decide whether to file an objection; the app will show until when, based on the formal delivery date. Do not pay before the fine becomes final, since the letter says payment is due only after it becomes final, within a further two weeks. If no objection is filed by the deadline shown, the fine becomes final and enforceable, and unpaid amounts can then lead to enforcement measures and extra costs. Consider legal advice if you want to contest the fine.
